exclusion_reason: The repository gates green today, but no freshness window or tag-reproducibility check exists yet.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the freshness gate enforces the declared window in CI and a tagged release rebuilds reproducibly from a clean clone.
expected_failing_assertion: No freshness gate exists and no tagged release has been rebuilt reproducibly.
active_gate_evidence: The roadmap workflow runs the full gate with immutable action on every push and pull request.
procedure: Clone the repository fresh and run the gate.
Age the default branch past the declared window in a drill and assert the freshness gate fails.
Rebuild a tagged release from a clean clone and compare the artifact.
pass_criterion: Over-age branch fails the freshness gate and the release rebuild matches.
